action.command:
for c in "dokumentenschwaerzung-pdf-pii-detector:pdf_pii_detector" "demos-einwendungsmanagement:demos_einwendungsmanagement_services"; do
  img=${c%%:*}; mod=${c##*:}
  printf "%-42s " "$img"
  timeout 50 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "/app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import ${mod}; print(\"import ok\")' 2>&1 | tail -1" 2>/dev/null
done
echo "kommentar-service entrypoint:"; grep -nE 'scripts\]|CMD|uvicorn' /workspace/02-backend/kommentar-service/Dockerfile
printf "%-42s " "kommentar-service (src.main)"
timeout 50 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh kommentar-service -c "/app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import src.main; print(\"import ok\")' 2>&1 | tail -1" 2>/dev/null
